paper_title: Earth as a transducer for dark-photon dark-matter detection
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon (chi), dimensionless, as plotted
notes: Paper proposes using Earth as transducer for kinetically-mixed dark-photon dark matter and summarizes a search in SuperMAG data (companion paper arXiv:2108.08852). Constrains kinetic mixing epsilon over mass range 2e-18 eV to 7e-17 eV (freq 6e-4 to 2e-2 Hz), assuming dark photon is all of DM, at 95% credible level. Actual numeric limits are only shown as a band in Fig. 4; no numerical table or explicit coupling values are provided in the text, so no reliable (mass, coupling) pairs could be extracted. Coupling type (DarkPhoton) is unambiguous.
